verdict.rationale: Poly documents user-controlled deletion: `rm` sends files to an Archive, and permanent deletion from that Archive is reserved for the user (blocked over MCP). Poly Mind memories can be inspected and edited, and Shared Drives keep their own archive. However, versions and conflict revisions are kept indefinitely by default, and nothing shows the user can configure retention. Missing for 10: configurable retention periods or policies, purging of version/Flashback history, deletion of derived indexes, transcripts and AI memories, account/data deletion workflow, independent corroboration.
